page.layout: One printed page. At full width at the top: a centred block of dedicatory headings in mixed roman, italic and capitals. Below it: a woodcut initial Q with the word RHETORICA beneath it at the left, and running text in two lines of paragraph beside and under it. Signature Bbbb at the foot, catchword "fa" at the right.

main_text.head: Nobilissimi, Amplissimi, Consultissimi ac Spectatissimi, Almæ hujus Academiæ CURATORES; Illustrium ac Præ-potentum ORDINUM FRISIÆ DEPUTATI gravissimi; MAGNIFICE D. RECTOR; Clarissimi, Consultissimi, Acutissimi, DD. PROFESSORES, Collegæ honorandi, VIRI NOBILES; Amplissimi, Consultissimi, ac Spectatissimi, DD. CONSULES; Reverendissimi ac Doctissimi, Mysteriorum Divinorum Dispensatores, Animarum PASTORES Vigilantissimi; Doctissimi ac Spectatissimi, DD. Doctores, Licentiati, ac Magistri; Amici, Consanguinei, & Affines denati Maκαρίτη; Cæteriq; Viri Doctiss. Honoratiss. ac Spectatissimi; Tuque Nobilissima, Doctissima, Lectissima, ac Ornatissima, Studiosorum Corona, Flos & decus Academiæ nostræ.
main_text.p: VANTIS calamitatum, miseriarum, ærumnarumque fluctibus gravissimis ac decumanis, genus humanum passim obnoxium sit: testatur continua ac jugis rerum humanarum tristis ac subitanea mutatio & catastrophe. Testatur in primis celeberrima ac famosissima hæc ACADEMIA PATRIAE, quæ proh dolor! non quotannis: verum singulis fermè semestribus aut trimestribus, gravissimo lethalique vulnere fauciatur ac lancinatur. Ut enim unda undam trudit: sic publicus luctus & squalor, publicum antecedentemque è vestigio subsequitur. Excessit, pronuper ex hac vita, camposq; Elysæos petijt, unde negant redire quenquam, Nobilissimus, Acutissimus nec non Theologorum hujus ævi facile Princeps JOHANNES MACCOVIUS S S. Theologiæ Doctor & Professor primarius, Collega conjunctissimus ac dilectissimus. Hoc gravissimo vulnere Academico non contenta, non

page.notes: The woodcut initial Q shows a standing female figure with a column; the label RHETORICA sits under it. The heading block is set in mixed type sizes. Show-through and a Google watermark at the lower right are not transcribed. Ornaments and small marks beside "Maκαρίτη" (Greek word, printed in Greek letters) are rendered approximately; the Greek is printed in small italic type. Some characters in the lower lines are damaged and may be inexact.
